title: Microsoft Teams Pluginhost Prototype Pollution Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Teams. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute script within the application window in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Pluginhost window. The issue results from the lack of control over modifications to attributes of object prototypes. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.
